tour.doctor.welcome: This guided tour shows you the essential features. You can skip it at any time.
tour.doctor.search: You can search for patients here: type the patient code, then click Search. You can also scan their QR code with the button on the right.
tour.doctor.prescribe: To prescribe tests, open a patient then click "Prescribe Exams". You will then be able to pick the analyses to run.
tour.doctor.patients: Find all your patients here along with their access history.
tour.doctor.exam_groups: Create reusable exam groups to prescribe faster.
tour.admin.welcome: This guided tour introduces the platform management tools.
tour.admin.users: Manage all accounts here: administrators, doctors, patients and laboratories.
tour.admin.invite: Invite your colleagues by email. They will securely activate their own account.
tour.admin.gdpr: Export data, review the incident register and apply the retention policy.
tour.admin.activity: Review the activity log and export it as a PDF for your audits.
tour.center.welcome: This guided tour introduces your laboratory management tools.
tour.center.exam_requests: Doctors' prescriptions arrive here. Track their status and manage them.
tour.center.samples: Register the specimens and print their barcodes for reliable tracking.
tour.center.scan: Scan a sample to find it instantly and enter its result.
tour.center.results: Enter the lab results; the patient can view them as soon as they are validated.
tour.center.billing: Manage invoices and CNAM reimbursements from the billing module.
tour.patient.welcome: This space lets you view your lab results and manage doctors' access to your data.
tour.patient.notifications: You will receive your notifications here: doctors' access requests, available results…
tour.patient.scan: Scan a doctor's QR code to grant them access to your results.
tour.patient.access: Approve or decline doctors' access requests here.
tour.patient.exams: Browse your exam request history and their results here.
